create:crafting_blueprint.behaviour1.name: Opens a _Crafting_ _menu_ allowing you to _configure_ a _recipe_ and items to display.

create:crafting_blueprint.behaviour2.name: _Applies_ the _configured_ _recipe_ with matching Ingredients found in your _Inventory_. _Sneak_ to craft up to a _Stack_ of items.

review.note: Kinetic (stress) engine: generators (water wheel, windmill, steam engine, hand crank), transmission (shafts, cogwheels, gearboxes), and machines that use stress (press, mixer, mill, saws, drills, deployers, arms), plus logistics (packagers, frogports, stock ticker) and trains. Stress not FE. Metal yield: crushing wheels turn ore blocks/raw ore into crushed raw ore, washed in fans to nuggets (see yields/create.json). Built-in support: AE2, Ars Nouveau, Farmer's Delight, Mystical Agriculture, Mekanism and many add-ons; Create is supported by 18 mods.
